rows.speaker: Renton

「Behold, Gym Ghingnham. This is the

rows.speaker: Dianna

「Know just how small it is to fight for
your own desire and pride, the way you

rows.en: Dianna! You...!!
rows.display_text: 「Dianna! You...!!」

rows.speaker: Dianna

「Gym Ghingnham... if my words won't
reach you...」

rows.en: ...then I will strike you down...! For the sake of everyone!

「...then I will strike you down...! For
the sake of everyone!」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham

rows.display_text:
「Dianna! $c! I won't let you get in the

rows.en: This world will be reborn at the far end of destruction!!

「This world will be reborn at the far
end of destruction!!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: I won't let that happen! We'll protect the lives living their utmost in this world!!
rows.display_text:
「I won't let that happen! We'll protect
the lives living their utmost in this
world!!」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: Enemy wipeout confirmed. Doesn't look like there's any reinforcements either.
rows.display_text:
「Enemy wipeout confirmed. Doesn't look
like there's any reinforcements either.」

rows.speaker: Sirius
rows.en: So it's over...
rows.display_text: 「So it's over...」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: No... this is where it starts.
rows.display_text: 「No... this is where it starts.」

rows.display_text:
「All units, return to base. From here, we
go after the Black Overman that commands

rows.display_text:
「From reports out of research facilities
all over, we've learned where that
Overman is headed.」

「The Japanese Alps... it seems that's
become the Executors' base.」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: The Japanese Alps, huh...
rows.display_text: 「The Japanese Alps, huh...」

rows.display_text:

worlds piled up after the spacetime
destruction -- no one sets foot there.」

rows.speaker: Holland

rows.display_text:
「A perfect home for a ghost of the
Black History, then.」

rows.speaker: Garrod

rows.display_text:
「But now that we know where he is,
there's only one thing left to do...!」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Let's go...! We'll bring that Overman down and put an end to this fight!

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Lady Dianna...

rows.display_text:
（Gym Ghingnham... the future doesn't lie
beyond destruction...）

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: If it's my fault you lost your way, then I'll make amends for it.
rows.display_text:
（If it's my fault you lost your way,
then I'll make amends for it.）

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: By striking down, with my own hand, the forbidden power that twists people's hearts...
rows.display_text:
（By striking down, with my own hand, the
forbidden power that twists people's
hearts...）

rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: Ridiculous! You mean to say the Turn X and I will be defeated a second time, not just once!
rows.display_text:
「Ridiculous! You mean to say the Turn X
and I will be defeated a second time, not
just once!」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: Those who drown in power are defeated by power...! Gym Ghingnham, prepare yourself!
rows.display_text:
「Those who drown in power are defeated
by power...! Gym Ghingnham, prepare
yourself!」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: But that is exactly the world I sought! The truth of battle itself!
rows.display_text:
「But that is exactly the world I sought!
The truth of battle itself!」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: Hahahahaha! My springtime has reached its very peak, right here!
rows.display_text:
「Hahahahaha! My springtime has reached
its very peak, right here!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Right to the end, that man is still...
rows.display_text: 「Right to the end, that man is still...」

rows.speaker: Harry
rows.en: A man who relied on power, who believed in nothing but power... a corpse possessed by a ghost of the Black History...
rows.display_text:
「A man who relied on power, believing in
nothing else... a corpse possessed by a
Black History ghost...」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: I refuse the world that man wants... a world where human lives keep being lost.
rows.display_text:
「I refuse the world that man wants... a
world where human lives keep being lost.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: So I'll fight. To protect the world I believe in.
rows.display_text:
「So I'll fight. To protect the world I
believe in.」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: How delightful! As long as I'm alive, I can enjoy thrilling battles like this one!
rows.display_text:
「How delightful! As long as I'm alive, I
can enjoy thrilling battles like this one!」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: That's a real pain for the rest of us! If you've joined the ghosts, just go back to sleep quietly in your ruins!
rows.display_text:
「That's a real pain for the rest of us!
If you've joined the ghosts, just go back
to sleep quietly in your ruins!」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: I won't have that! My springtime, and the Turn X's, begins right here, right now!
rows.display_text:
「I won't have that! My springtime, and
the Turn X's, begins right here, right
now!」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: Not bad at all, you! Fit to be my opponent!
rows.display_text:
「Not bad at all, you! Fit to be my
opponent!」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: Looks like a trip back from the grave has scrambled your head...
rows.display_text:
「Looks like a trip back from the grave
has scrambled your head...」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: What!?
rows.display_text: 「What!?」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: If you've forgotten getting the stuffing beaten out of you by us, I'll do it again as many times as it takes!
rows.display_text:
「If you've forgotten getting the
stuffing beaten out of you by us, I'll do
it again as many times as it takes!」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: So you never crawl back into a peaceful world again!!
rows.display_text:
「So you never crawl back into a peaceful
world again!!」

rows.speaker: Duke
rows.en: The world is moving toward peace...! There's no place in it for the likes of you, or ghosts of the Black History!
rows.display_text:
「The world is moving toward peace...!
There's no place in it for the likes of
you, or ghosts of the Black History!」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: To live is to fight! If there's no place for me, I'll just make one!
rows.display_text:
「To live is to fight! If there's no place
for me, I'll just make one!」

rows.speaker: Duke
rows.en: A heart that pushes others aside to get its own way -- that's what breeds war! We're putting an end to that root cause, right here!
rows.display_text:
「A heart that pushes others aside for
its own way -- that's what breeds war!
We end that root cause, right here!」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: This man... has he become a lackey of the Black History's ghost!?
rows.display_text:
「This man... has he become a lackey of
the Black History's ghost!?」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: Wrong, boy! If the Black History is an age of war, then I am the Black History itself!
rows.display_text:
「Wrong, boy! If the Black History is an
age of war, then I am the Black History
itself!」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: And to build a new Black History, I raise the banner of war right here, right now!
rows.display_text:
「And to build a new Black History, I
raise the banner of war right here, right
now!」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: I won't let you! We're fighting to stop that!
rows.display_text:
「I won't let you! We're fighting to stop
that!」

rows.display_text:
「The world moves forward, toward the
future! A ghost from the past disappears
right here!!」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: Hahaha, are you trembling, boy!? How adorable!
rows.display_text:
「Hahaha, are you trembling, boy!? How
adorable!」

rows.speaker: Keiko

losing to a guy like that!」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham

that much fighting spirit...」

rows.speaker: Kappei

rows.display_text:
「Someday the whole world becomes a
battlefield like this one...! By my hand,
and the hands of us ghosts!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Still don't get it, do you, Gym Ghingnham! Nobody wants a world like that!
rows.display_text:
「Still don't get it, do you, Gym

that!」

stars!」

ash!」

brute like you.」

grapes?」

「If that's what you want, I'll deal with
you in your own style.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: So go back to your grave quietly, ghost of the Black History!!
rows.display_text:
「So go back to your grave quietly, ghost
of the Black History!!」

rows.speaker: Kamille

「Why do you long for battle!? Is
watching lives get lost really that much
fun for you!?」

rows.en: Life shines because it's lost! Battle is exactly what amplifies the light of life!

「Life shines because it's lost! Battle is
exactly what amplifies the light of life!」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: In other words, it is the very meaning of human existence!

of human existence!」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: Don't you dare spout that logic, you who do nothing but take lives away!

「Don't you dare spout that logic, you
who do nothing but take lives away!」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: A man who knows nothing but fighting has no right to lecture anyone on the meaning of humanity!

「A man who knows nothing but fighting
has no right to lecture anyone on the
meaning of humanity!」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham

rows.display_text:
「Char Aznable! Some Psycommu-like
presence within the Turn X taught me of
your sins!」

rows.en: My sins, you say...?

rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: That's right! Allow me to tell you what you did at the end of the Black History!

you did at the end of the Black History!」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: There's no point in listening to something like that.

「There's no point in listening to
something like that.」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: What...?

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: I am Quattro Bajeena. I have no need to know Char Aznable's sins!
rows.display_text:
「I am Quattro Bajeena. I have no need
to know Char Aznable's sins!」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: As expected of you, Amuro Ray! No wonder you're the warrior who led the Black History to its end!
rows.display_text:
「As expected of you, Amuro Ray! No
wonder you're the warrior who led the
Black History to its end!」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: Is this what Lord Guin was talking about, my fight with Char...!?

「Is this what Lord Guin was talking
about, my fight with Char...!?」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: That's right! At heart, you're just the same as me! Someone who longs for battle!
rows.display_text:
「That's right! At heart, you're just the
same as me! Someone who longs for battle!」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: It's true, maybe fighting is the only way people like us know how to settle things...

「It's true, maybe fighting is the only
way people like us know how to settle
things...」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: But I can fight precisely because I believe there's a future waiting beyond it!

「But I can fight precisely because I
believe there's a future waiting beyond
it!」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: Don't you dare lump that together with your fighting, which only chases fleeting pleasure!
rows.display_text:
「Don't you dare lump that together with
your fighting, which only chases fleeting
pleasure!」

rows.en: I can't hand the world's future to someone who's made the wrong use of power!
rows.display_text:
「I can't hand the world's future to
someone who's made the wrong use of
power!」

「A Moonrace brat! But the people of the
Moon, who forgot the instinct to fight,
were living a slow death!」

rows.en: But I found the light called battle, and have lived a life that felt real!
rows.display_text:
「But I found the light called battle, and
have lived a life that felt real!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: There are other ways to make sure life feels real! Please understand that!

「There are other ways to make sure life
feels real! Please understand that!」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: And if you can't understand that, then I will fight you!!
rows.display_text:
「And if you can't understand that, then
I will fight you!!」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Man, seriously! Why can't you see how pointless a fight like this is!
rows.display_text:
「Man, seriously! Why can't you see how
pointless a fight like this is!」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: It's you who doesn't get it, boy!
rows.display_text: 「It's you who doesn't get it, boy!」

rows.speaker: Ghingnham
rows.en: Without battle, people forget the meaning of life! That's why I fight!
rows.display_text:
「Without battle, people forget the
meaning of life! That's why I fight!」

rows.speaker: Shinn

to do that!?」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: Seeing as it's a system humans made, it probably wasn't meant to drive the human race to complete extinction.
rows.display_text:
「Seeing as it's a system humans made, it
probably wasn't meant to drive the human
race to complete extinction.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: A moderate culling... or removing humanity from the Earth altogether -- that's likely the goal.
rows.display_text:
「A moderate culling... or removing
humanity from the Earth altogether --
that's likely the goal.」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: The Earth as sacred ground, humanity to live in space... an exercise of Elezmu's power, is it.
rows.display_text:
「The Earth as sacred ground, humanity
to live in space... an exercise of Elezmu's
power, is it.」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: I understand the logic, but is it something people should ever be allowed to do to other people...!
rows.display_text:
「I understand the logic, but is it
something people should ever be allowed
to do to other people...!」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: Someone who isn't even there passing indiscriminate judgment on others -- that can never be allowed...!
rows.display_text:
「Someone who isn't even there passing
indiscriminate judgment on others -- that
can never be allowed...!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: But this system has actually been activated once before, a long time ago.
rows.display_text:
「But this system has actually been
activated once before, a long time ago.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: ...The world where the Moonrace and the Innocents once lived, you mean.
rows.display_text:
「...The world where the Moonrace and the
Innocents once lived, you mean.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Exactly.
rows.display_text: 「Exactly.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Don't tell me...!
rows.display_text: 「Don't tell me...!」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: That's right... at the end of the Black History, the Turn A used the Moonlight Butterfly to bury civilization.
rows.display_text:
「That's right... at the end of the Black
History, the Turn A used the Moonlight
Butterfly to bury civilization.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: And after that, people rejected mechanical civilization to protect the natural environment...
rows.display_text:
「And after that, people rejected
mechanical civilization to protect the
natural environment...」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Some moved their lives to the moon or to space to wait for nature's recovery, while others deliberately chose harsh environments to live in.
rows.display_text:
「Some moved to the moon or space to
wait out nature's recovery; others
deliberately chose harsh places to live.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: So the Moonrace's existence, the rejection of mechanical civilization, and the life afterward in Zora and Siberia -- that all amounts to rebirth after destruction.
rows.display_text:
「The Moonrace's existence, rejecting
machines, then life in Zora and Siberia --
all of it's rebirth after destruction.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: The Turn A's Moonlight Butterfly and Overdevil's Overfreeze were probably weapons against the Shadow Angels, but not only that...
rows.display_text:
「Probably, Turn A's Moonlight Butterfly,
Overdevil's Overfreeze were anti-Shadow
Angel weapons, not only that...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Just like those drones, they likely also served as a force carrying out the Executor System's destruction.
rows.display_text:
「Just like those drones, they likely also
served as a force carrying out the
Executor System's destruction.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: So that's why the Turn A ran out of control, in step with the system's activation...
rows.display_text:
「So that's why the Turn A ran out of
control, in step with the system's
activation...」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Then what about King Gainer!?
rows.display_text: 「Then what about King Gainer!?」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: That Overman is said to be a special existence they call an Early Overman, but...
rows.display_text:
「That Overman is said to be a special
existence they call an Early Overman,
but...」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Are you saying King Gainer has power like Overdevil's too!?
rows.display_text:
「Are you saying King Gainer has power
like Overdevil's too!?」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: I don't know that. ...But judging from how the Turn A and King Gainer have behaved so far...
rows.display_text:
「I don't know that. ...But judging from
how the Turn A and King Gainer have
behaved so far...」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: As long as a person is piloting it, it shouldn't run out of control.
rows.display_text:
「As long as a person is piloting it, it
shouldn't run out of control.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Well, that's a relief, for now at least.
rows.display_text: 「Well, that's a relief, for now at least.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Y-yeah...
rows.display_text: 「Y-yeah...」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: I've got a bad feeling about this... like there's something more to King Gainer than that...
rows.display_text:
（I've got a bad feeling about this... like
there's something more to King Gainer
than that...）

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: ...That's everything we managed to learn.
rows.display_text:
「...That's everything we managed to
learn.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: And this person who told you all this -- where are they now?
rows.display_text:
「And this person who told you all this
-- where are they now?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: They said they'd be watching to see where the world's headed, for the time being.
rows.display_text:
「They said they'd be watching to see
where the world's headed, for the time
being.」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: Could that person be...?
rows.display_text: 「Could that person be...?」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: That's enough, Sochie. That person must have lent their help precisely because they too were worried about the future.
rows.display_text:
「That's enough, Sochie. That person must
have helped us precisely because they too
were worried about the future.」

rows.speaker: Sochie
rows.en: Understood, Lady Dianna.
rows.display_text: 「Understood, Lady Dianna.」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: Now that we know the drones' purpose, we have to stop that system as soon as possible.
rows.display_text:
「Now that we know the drones' purpose,
we have to stop that system as soon as
possible.」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: Given the nature of its purpose, there's also a chance a weapon of destruction is being prepared that could engulf the whole world.
rows.display_text:
「Given its purpose, there's also a chance
a weapon of destruction is being prepared
that could engulf the whole world.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Night ends, and morning comes. From the land of the rising sun, the sun rises again...
rows.display_text:
「Night ends, and morning comes. From the
land of the rising sun, the sun rises
again...」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Judging from that line, it's all but certain the Executor System is connected to Japan.
rows.display_text:
「Judging from that line, it's all but
certain the Executor System is connected
to Japan.」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: The fact that Japan alone hasn't been hit by the drones backs that up too.
rows.display_text:
「The fact that Japan alone hasn't been
hit by the drones backs that up too.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: There's probably a control device for the system somewhere in Japan, along with whoever's operating it.
rows.display_text:
「There's probably a control device for
the system somewhere in Japan, along with
whoever's operating it.」

rows.speaker: Shaya
rows.en: So if we defeat that person, then...
rows.display_text: 「So if we defeat that person, then...」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: That ridiculous system will probably stop too.
rows.display_text:
「That ridiculous system will probably
stop too.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: For now, let's keep heading south to the Kushiro Plain in Hokkaido.
rows.display_text:
「For now, let's keep heading south to
the Kushiro Plain in Hokkaido.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: There's a Mountain Cycle there too. Investigating it might tell us something.
rows.display_text:
「There's a Mountain Cycle there too.
Investigating it might tell us something.」

rows.speaker: Tsugumi
rows.en: But... the mastermind might have already left Japan by now...
rows.display_text:
「But... the mastermind might have already
left Japan by now...」

rows.speaker: Jun
rows.en: If that's the case, this would all be a complete waste of effort.
rows.display_text:
「If that's the case, this would all be a
complete waste of effort.」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Enough grumbling, let's move! We don't have any other leads!
rows.display_text:
「Enough grumbling, let's move! We don't
have any other leads!」

rows.en: That's right.
rows.display_text: 「That's right.」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: There you are, old man.
rows.display_text: 「There you are, old man.」

rows.speaker: Rena
rows.en: You're not surprised today.
rows.display_text: 「You're not surprised today.」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: Guess you've finally gotten used to it.
rows.display_text: 「Guess you've finally gotten used to it.」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Don't underestimate me. I've grown too, you know.
rows.display_text:
「Don't underestimate me. I've grown too,
you know.」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: Hmph... seems the trial of battle has toughened your spirit a little.
rows.display_text:
「Hmph... seems the trial of battle has
toughened your spirit a little.」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: Overcoming a trial is how people, and the world, move to the next stage. Through the repetition of failure and success... destruction and rebirth.
rows.display_text:
「Overcoming trials moves people, and the
world, forward -- through repeated
failure, success... destruction and rebirth.」

rows.speaker: Reika
rows.en: Destruction and rebirth...
rows.display_text: 「Destruction and rebirth...」

rows.speaker: Sirius
rows.en: Are you talking about the Executor System?
rows.display_text:
「Are you talking about the Executor
System?」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: Now, who's to say...
rows.display_text: 「Now, who's to say...」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Old man... I've been thinking about this for a while now, but aren't you someone who knows everything?
rows.display_text:
「Old man... I've been thinking about this
for a while now, but aren't you someone
who knows everything?」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: And on top of that, aren't you enjoying watching us all flail around!?
rows.display_text:
「And on top of that, aren't you enjoying
watching us all flail around!?」

rows.speaker: Pierre
rows.en: Calm down, Apollo.
rows.display_text: 「Calm down, Apollo.」

rows.speaker: Silvia
rows.en: That's right. The commander isn't all-knowing either, you know.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. The commander isn't
all-knowing either, you know.」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: ...Then let me ask you this. Do you reject the cycle of destruction and rebirth, for the sake of evolution?
rows.display_text:
「...Then let me ask you this. Do you
reject the cycle of destruction and
rebirth, for the sake of evolution?」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: To hell with that...! I've had enough of people dying for something like that!
rows.display_text:
「To hell with that...! I've had enough of
people dying for something like that!」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Evolution or whatever, if you want to move forward, there are plenty of other ways to do it!
rows.display_text:
「Evolution or whatever, if you want to
move forward, there are plenty of other
ways to do it!」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: Then stop it, and prove it.
rows.display_text: 「Then stop it, and prove it.」

rows.speaker: Fudo
rows.en: A ghost of the Black History... the pain of the past that this world carries on its back.
rows.display_text:
「A ghost of the Black History... the pain
of the past that this world carries on
its back.」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: You don't need to tell me that...!
rows.display_text: 「You don't need to tell me that...!」
